newsitem.title: UK: UK pharmaceutical shares firm, encouraged by U.S.
newsitem.headline: UK pharmaceutical shares firm, encouraged by U.S.

text.p: Shares in Zeneca Group Plc, SmithKline Beecham Plc and Glaxo Welcome Plc moved ahead on Monday, encouraged by a stronger close to Wall Street on Friday.
"It's just a reflection of the fact that the U.S. market was up overall. The sector also took a bit of a beating last week and so its due a rebound," said one dealer.

Zeneca was up 23-1/2p, or 1.13 percent, at 2107p, SmithKline Beecham stock rose 19p to 1223 pence and Glaxo Welcome gained 16p to reach 1334 pence at 0900 GMT. NatWest re-iterated its positive stance on the sector in a monthly note.
Figures from market researcher IMS International released on July 7 also helped underpin the sector.

The data showed that pharmaceutical sales in the world's top ten markets rose by six percent in the first four months of 1997. In Europe, the IMS figures indicated, the rate of growth improved to four percent in local currency terms from three percent.
